description: Query rows from a dataset snapshot the connected key owner has purchased. This is for buyer-owned point-in-time snapshots, not live CREHQ refresh. The response includes snapshot_as_of, hosted_access_until, artifact basis, and row results. If hosted access expired, it returns an upgrade/update-plan message while acknowledging that the buyer still owns the original file snapshot.

purchase_id.description: Specific CREHQ purchase id from crehq_purchased_datasets_list.

q.description: Optional text search across name/address/city/store id.

radius.description: Radius in miles for lat/lng search, max 250.

name: crehq_purchased_dataset_locations
